sources.entry: Plainpad - Modern note taking application for the cloud, utilizing the best features of progressive web apps technology. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-3.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: Plainpad is a self-hosted, PWA-style note-taking application that runs on your own server via Docker.
summary.what_it_does: Plainpad is a self-hosted note-taking app, described as built for simplicity and stability. The README says it runs on your own server, so you keep ownership of your data. Setup is through Docker Compose: clone the repository and start it with docker compose up -d. The README notes the current setup works with Windows, WSL and Docker. It includes an optional standalone DemoSeeder (run manually with php artisan) that fills the database with sample medical-student study notes and creates a demo user. The README gives no detailed feature list beyond note taking.
use_cases: personal notes on your own server
keeping notes off third-party cloud services
trying out a note app with demo data
how_to_run: Optional demo data: php artisan db:seed --class=DemoSeeder (from the server directory or inside the app container)
notable: Self-hosted, so notes stay on your own server
Single Docker Compose command to start
Optional demo seeder with realistic sample notes
Re-running the demo seeder refreshes notes without duplicates
caveats: README says the current setup works with Windows, WSL and Docker; no other platforms are named
Requires Docker to run as documented
README has little detail on features or configuration
